parameters.text:
=Analyze the document below and extract its real content.

Extract these header fields:
- report_ref: the report reference number (e.g. PL019_2026)
- vessel_name: name of the vessel
- port: port of discharge
- survey_date: date of survey in YYYY-MM-DD format
- bl_number: Bill of Lading number
- shipper: shipper company name
- consignee: consignee company name

Extract every chapter AND subchapter as individual chunks.

Return exactly this structure (replace all values with real content from the document):
{
  "report_ref": "<extracted value>",
  "vessel_name": "<extracted value>",
  "port": "<extracted value>",
  "survey_date": "<YYYY-MM-DD>",
  "bl_number": "<extracted value>",
  "shipper": "<extracted value>",
  "consignee": "<extracted value>",
  "chunks": [
    {
      "chapter_number": 1,
      "chapter_title": "<real title>",
      "subchapter_number": null,
      "subchapter_title": null,
      "content": "<full text of this chapter>"
    },
    {
      "chapter_number": 7,
      "chapter_title": "<real title>",
      "subchapter_number": "7.1",
      "subchapter_title": "<real subchapter title>",
      "content": "<full text of subchapter 7.1>"
    }
  ]
}

Rules:
- Every subchapter (4.1, 4.2, 6.1, 7.1, 7.2 etc.) must be a separate chunk
- content must contain the complete text of that section
- Use only information present in the document
- Return ONLY the JSON object, no explanation

Document:
{{ $json.text }}

messageValues.message: You are a document processing orchestrator. Return ONLY a valid JSON object. No explanation, no markdown, no backticks.
